name: Infinite Staircase
steps: Tap the paper scroll to read the rules.
Tap the Up arrow after spotting the handprint.
Tap the Down arrow when everything looks normal.
Tap the Up arrow after the lights start flashing.
Tap the Up arrow in the dark hallway.
Tap the Up arrow after noticing the strange poster.
Ignore the old lady and tap the Down arrow.
Tap the Up arrow after seeing the creepy painting.
Tap the Down arrow when the floor looks normal.
Tap the exit door to complete the level.
